title: Agree source, crop, field and API contracts

acceptance.text: Draft stable field, crop and source identifiers
acceptance.evidence: s01 draft ready for review in docs/API_CONTRACT.md: agreed coverage/audit targets, stable IDs, preserved v2 and proposed extensions, full operation/common-period semantics, separate statuses, four indicators and six synthetic JSON blocks. JSON parsing/cardinality checks, actual v2 A/B round-trips and D rejection, all 60 workflow/PR tests and whitespace checks passed. Technical-owner agreement is still pending, so s01 remains in_progress rather than an accepted checkbox; s02-s06 and G1 are not completed.
acceptance.how: Agree pilot coverage, stable IDs, short intake, equal previous/current crop IDs, dated history, usual baseline/fallow and common horizon; propose comparison bundle and per-plan statuses.
acceptance.verification: Every technical owner can distinguish an assessed baseline, complete alternative and incomplete bundle without guessing units.

acceptance.how: Saim specifies parameter IDs, time standard, period, units, missingness and grid support; do not insert invented values.
acceptance.verification: Fardin/Prachurjo can consume one versioned schema without guessing units.

acceptance.how: Define essentiality, pass/fail/caution/unknown, reviewed rule IDs/sources, calendars/duration and soil/water/host constraints; exclude fertilizer and nutrient-depletion calculations.
acceptance.verification: The rules distinguish unknown/unsupported from actual exclusions.

acceptance.how: Map three priority presets, comparison matrix, quick crop check, check ledger, replay and print/JSON receipt to API states; keep the form progressive.
acceptance.verification: No failed API is replaced with a fabricated success.

acceptance.how: Freeze reviewed payload examples, deterministic preset/tie-break rules, period comparability and canonical input/result fingerprinting.
acceptance.verification: Four technical owners agree schemas and synthetic shape cases; fingerprints exclude volatile timestamps and imply no scientific certification.

acceptance.text: Review, merge and announce G1 handoffs
acceptance.how: Record independent review and actual main-branch revision; G1 owners update their branches.
acceptance.verification: Acceptance/checks/review/merge evidence is real before dependent work starts.
